notes.title: Who is Anton Cornwell in ALTERITY EXPERIENCE?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35920513/b54e3db090f58c9b8e08664f4e3e7036d6ecccce.png[/img]

In [i]ALTERITY EXPERIENCE[/i], you are Anton Cornwell.

Since a few months, Anton and his wife Betty inherited the Cornwell family's ranch. Installed with their two children Chloe and Damon, Anton is a farmer and Betty is a veterinarian.

Enjoying working the land, Anton is passionate about his many activities on the ranch and spends a lot of time modernizing the farm to make it a place where high quality organic agricultural produce is grown.

But recently, Anton has to deal with strange phenomenons of unknown origin that could jeopardize his ranch and his family ... 👽🛸

Some details about Anton:
[list][*] Nationality: American
[*] Sex: male
[*] Blood group: A+
[*] Height: 5'-11''
[*] Weight: 175 Ib
[*] Age: 35 years old
[*] Birth date: August 31st, 1984
[*] Birthplace: Modesto, California
[*] Home address: Cornwell Ranch, Firefly Road, Archimedes, CA 95500
[*] Marital status: married, two children
[*] Job: farmer[/list]
